messages:
IncidentBot: PagerDuty alert PID-48211 fired -> /v1/complete high 5xx rate (eu-west-1). Severity: P2. Autoscaler thrash observed. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PID-48211
Maria: acked. I'm on it. pulling logs and checking routing.
Ajay: ack. standing by to take handoff if needed.
Maria: quick note: spike started ~2m ago, 90s tail on KV cache evictions, many `net/http 504` in prod-proxy.
Tim: saw similar in metrics - concurrent inflight tokens jumped after a retry storm. autoscaler oscillating between 2/8 pods.
Liz: customer impact: some enterprise customers report generation failures, % of requests failing ~3-4% region-wide. CS alerted.
Maria: running targeted drain on one hot pod to break the retry loop. cmd:
```
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/pool-inference-eu-1
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/pool-inference-eu-1 --replicas=4
```
Maria: also temporarily reducing autoscaler sensitivity and raising min replicas to 4 to stop rapid spinning.
Ajay: +1. if drain doesn't reduce 5xx in 60s we fallback to model-compact in the eu route (lower perf but stable).
Maria: applied autoscaler patch (scaled to min=4); watching error rate.
Ops-Oncall: tagging oncall-runbook v2 -> check circuit-breaker thresholds and prefix cache hit rates.
Maria: cache eviction looks like main factor - KV hit rate dropped from 98% -> 62% for long prompts. prefix-cache flushes aligned with pods restarting.
Tim: can we rate-limit retries at proxy level while this stabilizes? small rule to change from 5->2 retries.
Maria: added retry cap in envoy config (hotpatch): `retries: 2` and reloaded.
Liz: CS says errors decreased for Customer X after your restart, they're seeing restored throughput.
IncidentBot: PID-48211 acknowledged by Maria. Status: mitigations applied (scale + retry cap + restart). Monitor window: 10m.
Ajay: I'll take watch for the next 15. Maria, ping me if you need escalation to Dedicated pool fallback.
Maria: thanks — will update in 5m with metrics snapshot. :thumbsup:
Tim: logging note: capture the `proxy->inference` tail traces (span ids) for the window 3249943140-3249943340.
Maria: grabbing traces now, will attach to the incident record.
Liz: customer comms queued: short PSA noting transient errors and resolution steps.
Maria: prelim status: error rate down 70%, KV hit on hot keys recovering. Keeping this in progress until stable.
Ajay: roger. If it resurges I'll escalate to platform lead and open a bridge.
IncidentBot: Update: PID-48211 status -> acknowledged (Maria), watching. Next auto-escalation in 12m if symptoms persist.
